About

Behavior Analyst, Researcher and Digital Systems Designer.

Juan Lopez studies how environments, information, and experiences affect people, then carries that understanding into clearer, more humane systems.

A shared foundation

Observation and implementation belong together.

Behavior analysis is Juan's primary lens. It brings careful observation, repeated measurement, individualized context, and socially meaningful outcomes into the same conversation.

Research, web development, Shopify theme work, e-commerce, and information design are extensions of that foundation. They are ways to make environments clearer—not tactics for manipulating people.

Across independent client work, Juan has handled strategy, information architecture, visual design, development, responsive implementation, content structure, forms, business email, payments, domain configuration, and launch.

He is completing FIU degrees in Psychology on the Applied Behavior Analysis track and Natural and Applied Sciences. His current credentials include Registered Behavior Technician certification and CITI Social/Behavioral Human Research training.

Research

Questions with boundaries

Juan's Fall 2025 AI Misattribution project used an online experiment, Qualtrics, and IBM SPSS to test how source expectations affect social evaluation.

Client systems

Complete website delivery

SitePad projects show end-to-end work for service businesses, including forms, email, payments, responsive design, domains, and launch.

Commerce

Shopify theme development

World Cup Items and VX Nexus demonstrate independent theme development, merchandising, art direction, commerce setup, and responsive storefront work.
